_comment: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for BuddyPept. Configured but inactive until SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is added to .env.local. To activate: (1) Go to https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens and create a Personal Access Token. (2) Add SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=sbp_... to .env.local. (3) Restart Claude Code. The Supabase MCP server is set to --read-only by default for safety; remove that flag when you need write access for migrations.
